messages:
Sam: Short RFC follow-up: we need a clear canonical flow for provisional token -> confirmed lease to avoid billing and double-admit issues. High level suggestion below.

Rina: Love to see the flow. Key constraints: token fastpath must stay single-RPC for latency. Any confirm/convert must be async and idempotent.

Sam: Agreed. Flow sketch: 1) Edge admits via token and returns provisional_id header. 2) If tenant crosses threshold, edge enqueues a confirm request. 3) Central confirms -> returns lease_id and emits mapping provisional->lease. 4) Billing and downstream systems dedupe by provisional_id -> prefer lease_id if present.

Tobias: Failure cases: central never confirms (network partition) -> provisional should expire and emit provisional_expiry event. Billing must treat expired provisionals as single token unit.

Rina: Also need confirm batching to avoid write amplification. Edge confirmer should batch provisional confirms every 100ms or 500 reqs, whichever sooner. Include retry/backoff and tombstone writes on revoke.

Sam: Telemetry: provisional_confirm_latency_p99, provisional_expiry_count, confirm_batch_size, fallback_to_token_rate. Alert if provisional_expiry_count spikes > 1% of admits in 5m.

Tobias: API minimal shapes: POST /admit -> {admit:true, mode:"token", provisional_id:"p-...", ttl_ms:"5000"} PUT /confirm -> {status:"leased", lease_id:"L-..."} or {status:"revoked"}. Headers: X-Admit-Id present on every forwarded request.

Rina: Runbook snippets: if confirm_latency_p99 > 2s, check central replica lag, confirmer queue backlog, and flip canary to fallback-only. Pager threshold: fallback_to_token_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m.

Sam: Owners: eng-platform Sam+Rina, eng-sre Tobias. Timeline: spike 1w, prototype 2w, staging canary, prod ramp with kill-switch. I'll draft the RFC follow-up and include test matrix (central down, delayed confirm, batch loss).

ops-bot: Meeting created: Thu 11:00am PT "Provisional->Lease handshake scrub". Reminder 24h.

Tobias: I'll add the confirm batching heuristic doc and a small perf harness for confirm path.
